Name: Laish, Father of Palti
Summary: Laish of Gallim is named as the father of Phalti, to whom Saul gave Michal (called Phaltiel in 2 Samuel 3:15) after taking her from David.
KeyStory: Laish's son became a pawn in Saul's struggle against David.
LifeLesson: A father's name survives in his son's story, even a sorrowful one.
